name: r-bundle-landis
description: The r-bundle-research set plus r-landis-ii, for a project that writes LANDIS-II inputs and reads its outputs. Add r-bundle-targets alongside when the runs are driven from a {targets} pipeline.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-bundle-research
description: One entry that enables the plugins every R research project uses on every session: r-project-core, r-geospatial, r-reporting, r-code-review and r-package-dev. Enabling it enables those; r-package-dev in turn pulls the r-lib skills it defers to. It carries no framework: add r-bundle-targets for a {targets} pipeline, and r-bundle-spades or r-bundle-landis for a simulation project.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-bundle-spades
description: The r-bundle-research set plus r-spades, for a project that develops or runs SpaDES modules. Add r-bundle-targets alongside when the modules run from a {targets} pipeline.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-bundle-targets
description: The r-bundle-research set plus r-targets, for a project built as a {targets} pipeline.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-code-review
description: Read-only review subagents for the failure classes that research R code produces instead of errors: spatial correctness, dependency declaration, and failed or suspiciously clean runs. Plus the measure-against-an-independent-reference method these projects use to catch bugs that no test would have caught.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-geospatial
description: Spatial data work in R that survives serialisation, parallel workers and large rasters: the terra external-pointer trap and how to avoid needing wrap(), one declared project CRS, the sf geometry-repair sequence distilled from repeated corrective commits, out-of-core raster and vector strategies, and the silent-wrong-answer failures that spatial code produces instead of errors.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-landis-ii
description: Driving LANDIS-II from R: input validation before a run (because LANDIS fails on bad input in the worst possible way -- non-zero exit, empty stderr, the real message buried in a log inside a scratch dir), the raster and text-format conventions it silently depends on, container execution on shared storage, and the output-reading rules including the geotransform y-flip that invalidated a full calibration with no error at all.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-package-dev
description: Deltas on top of the r-lib package-development skills, not a replacement for them: the development-to-main change workflow for co-developed packages (branch and submodule checks, local tests, CI, merge, install into the project from remote main), per-package overrides the r-lib skills cannot know, the dependency-declaration failures that dominate this corpus, and hooks that catch roxygen/NAMESPACE drift and the recurring .claude R CMD check NOTE.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-project-core
description: Baseline conventions and deterministic guardrails for R-based research projects: fixing defects at their root cause, air formatting, ASCII-only code and reports, citation integrity, the .Rprofile/_local.R/_hosts.R config split, hermetic tests and CI for projects that are not packages, long runs on shared machines, commit discipline, and PreToolUse guards against destructive commands, hand-editing generated files, and mutating the library while a long run is live.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-reporting
description: Reports and provenance for research deliverables: writing for a stated audience (the user is always asked who the reader is; plain-language summary first, technical detail later or in appendices, no jargon or machine-written phrasing), Quarto project-mode path behaviour and the stale-PDF trap, rendering from a pipeline, deriving report numbers from the pipeline so prose cannot drift, draft marking for AI-assisted content, and input manifests and reproducibility receipts. Chart design is left to the dataviz and r-lib:alt-text skills.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-spades
description: Developing and wiring SpaDES modules: the defineModule metadata contract and why it must be read rather than inferred, the .inputObjects timing trap that silently mutates data, reqdPkgs remote specs and nested-module package loading, module renaming, and eight years of accumulated Cache() lessons ending in targets-owns-the-cache.
author: FOR-CAST

name: r-targets
description: Building, testing, debugging and running {targets} pipelines: a tested static validator on top of the general test suite and CI, multi-project stores and the definition-time vs run-time contract, spatial objects and geotargets in the store, launching and stopping runs on shared machines with crew controllers sized to fit, a pipeline-invalidation review agent, and the silent-staleness traps that make pipelines report clean runs while producing wrong answers.
author: FOR-CAST
